filters.label: Integration
filters.description: Blank for all. e.g. partner-api-gfis@tatvacare.in, WhatsApp

name: Integration Endpoint Breakdown
query:
SELECT
	endpoint                                              AS "Endpoint:Data:230",
	COUNT(*)                                              AS "Calls:Int:80",
	SUM(is_error)                                         AS "Errors:Int:80",
	SUM(error_code = 'rate_limited')                      AS "Rate limited:Int:110",
	SUM(error_code IN ('validation_error','bad_request')) AS "Bad payload:Int:110",
	SUM(error_code IN ('unauthorized','forbidden'))       AS "Auth:Int:80",
	SUM(error_code IN ('server_error','server_busy'))     AS "Our fault:Int:100",
	SUM(error_code = 'not_found')                         AS "Not found:Int:100",
	ROUND(AVG(duration_ms))                               AS "Avg ms:Int:80",
	MAX(duration_ms)                                      AS "Slowest ms:Int:100",
	MIN(request_time)                                     AS "First call:Datetime:170",
	MAX(request_time)                                     AS "Last call:Datetime:170"
FROM `tabCRM API Request Log`
WHERE request_time >= %(from_datetime)s
	AND (%(integration)s = '' OR source = %(integration)s)
	AND (%(lane)s = '' OR channel = %(lane)s)
GROUP BY endpoint
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
